title: A gate option that names a token budget floor ('a 200-token floor per question') is classed secrets
goal: bl_authority reads a hyphenated count of tokens used as a budget (a 200-token floor, a 600-token budget) as a model's token count, so a gate that names one stays design; a credential token keeps secrets. Seen on ST-6n5xrkbt gate g2 during SP-n7f53pgv.
